listMembers.usage:
params = ListMembersParams(
    sort=SortOrder.ASC,
    role=MemberRole.ADMIN,
    roles=[MemberRole.ADMIN],
    region=Region.EU
)
response = await client.members.list_members(params=params)

updateMember.usage:
request = MemberUpdateRequest(role=MemberRole.ADMIN, kind=MemberKind.REGULAR)
response = await client.members.update_member(id=123, request=request)
updateMember.output: Member(id: int, role: MemberRole, status: MemberStatus, previous_statuses: list[MemberStatus] | None)
